fine_lines.title: how vs how old vs how many
fine_lines.explanation_ar: how وحدها = كيف (How are you? كيف حالك). how old = كم عمر. how many = كم عدد، ويأتي بعدها اسم جمع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: How alone asks about condition (How are you?). How old asks about age. How many asks about number and takes a plural noun.

examples.sentence: How are you? I'm fine, thanks.
How old are you? I'm ten.
How many books are there? Three.

fine_lines.title: How are you? (one) vs (many)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: How are you? تُقال لشخص أو لمجموعة. الشخص يرد: I'm fine. والمجموعة ترد: We're fine.
fine_lines.explanation_en: How are you? can be for one person or a group. One person answers I'm fine. A group answers We're fine.

examples.sentence: How are you, Sami? I'm fine, thanks.
How are you, Tom and Lucy? We're fine, thanks.

fine_lines.title: thank you vs thanks
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى شكرًا. thanks أقصر وأقل رسمية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the same. Thanks is shorter and more informal.

grammar.title: What's your name?
grammar.explanation_ar: What's = What is (ما يكون). your = الخاص بك. name = اسم. فالسؤال: ما اسمك؟ والإجابة: My name is ... أو I'm ... (أو الاسم فقط).
grammar.explanation_en: What's = what is. Your = belonging to you. Answer: My name is ... or I'm ... (or just your name).
examples: What's your name? My name is Karen.

grammar.title: How are you?
grammar.explanation_ar: how = كيف. How are you? = كيف حالك/حالكم. الإجابة: I'm fine, thank you. أو للمجموعة: We're fine, thanks. ونضع فاصلة قبل thank you.
grammar.explanation_en: How = in what condition. How are you? Answer: I'm fine, thank you. A group says: We're fine, thanks. Put a comma before thank you.
examples: How are you, Sami? I'm fine, thanks.
How are you, Dina, Ola and Hazem? We're fine, thanks.

grammar.title: How old ... ?
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال عن العمر: How old + am/is/are + الفاعل؟ الإجابة القصيرة: I'm six. والإجابة الطويلة: I'm six years old. مع اسم مفرد نستخدم is: How old is Tom? He's five.
grammar.explanation_en: To ask about age: How old + am/is/are + subject? Short answer: I'm six. Long answer: I'm six years old. With one name use is: How old is Tom? He's five.
examples: How old are you? I'm ten.
How old is Amira? She's six years old.
How old are they? They're eight.

grammar.title: How many + plural noun
grammar.explanation_ar: how many = كم عدد، ويأتي بعدها اسم جمع دائمًا: How many cats? وليس How many cat. وفي الإجابة نذكر الرقم ثم الاسم جمعًا: three carrots.
grammar.explanation_en: How many asks about number and is always followed by a plural noun: How many cats? (not cat). Answer with a number + plural noun: three carrots.

grammar.title: Numbers 1-10
grammar.explanation_ar: الأرقام من 1 إلى 10: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. بعد one يكون الاسم مفردًا، وبعد بقية الأرقام يكون جمعًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Numbers 1-10: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. After one, the noun is singular; after the others, it is plural.
